units.source_text: 次日夫人醒来，狂病依然未愈，样子非常痛苦。

en.t: The next day, the lady woke, but her madness had still not healed, and she looked terribly distressed.
So they performed the rites and prayers once more.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将也在心中祈愿：但望目前平安无事，早早恢复正常。

en.t: General Higekuro also prayed inwardly that, for now, all would remain safe and that she would soon return to normal.

units.source_text: 他想：我若不曾见过她正常时的可爱之相，决不能忍耐到现在，

en.t: He thought, If I had never seen how lovely she was when she was herself, I could never have endured this until now,
for this state of hers is truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 到了傍晚，他照例急急忙忙地准备出门。

en.t: When evening came, he hurriedly prepared to go out as usual.

units.source_text: 此时他的服装很不端整，奇形怪状，不成体统，为此牢骚满腹。

en.t: At that moment his clothing was terribly disordered, strange-looking, and improper, and he was full of complaints about it.

units.source_text: 没有人取出漂亮些的袍子来替他换上，样子甚是可怜。

en.t: No one brought out a nicer robe for him to change into, which made him look quite pitiable.

units.source_text: 昨夜那件袍子被灰烬烧破了好几处，有一股焦臭，异常难闻。

en.t: The robe from the night before had been burned through in several places by the ashes and gave off an extremely unpleasant scorched smell.
Even his undergarment had absorbed the scorched odor.

units.source_text: 这显然表示夫人打翻了醋瓶，玉鬘见了一定厌恶他。

en.t: This plainly showed that his wife had been overcome with jealousy, and if Tamakazura saw him, she would surely be disgusted.

units.source_text: 于是把衣服脱光，洗一个澡，好好地打扮一下。

en.t: So he stripped off his clothes, bathed, and carefully dressed himself again.

units.source_text: 木工君替他把衣服熏香，对他吟道：

en.t: Mokunokimi scented his clothes for him and recited to him:
